Today, HP lent its support to NVIDIA's Open Agent Safety Platform, a new full-stack approach designed to strengthen AI security throughout the full agent stack, including infrastructure, models, agent harnesses, runtime software and robotic systems. HP will build AI infrastructure components using built-in NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform technologies. "Security can’t be something we add later, it has to be built in from the start," said Bruce Broussard, interim CEO of HP Inc. "That's why HP is proud to support NVIDIA and its Open Agent Safety Platform and collaborate across the industry to help advance a more secure, governed approach to AI adoption. Innovation matters, but so do transparency, security and good governance if we want customers to adopt AI with confidence." This commitment builds on HP’s longstanding collaboration with NVIDIA and reflects HP’s broader approach to help customers unlock the value of AI with the security and control needed to adopt and scale it with confidence.
